job.title: Software Engineer - Data Protection
job.pay_full: $131,400 – $197,200 a year US base pay range (set by work location, skills and experience), plus bonus potential, equity and benefits

details.about: Rubrik's Database Data Protection team builds products that protect customers' database deployments (SQL Server and Oracle) in data centers and in the cloud, making it easier to protect database workloads and faster to recover from unexpected events. The products are widely adopted, so the work reaches a large number of enterprises. Engineers work closely with product managers, designers and other engineers, with autonomy and responsibility rather than just tasks.
duties: Own the design, development and testing of new features end to end (full stack) that protect customers' SQL Server and Oracle databases in data centers and the cloud
Troubleshoot issues found by customers and in internal product testing, and deliver robust fixes
needs: Degree in Computer Science or a related field
Proficiency in C++ and Scala, or Java
A strong interest in, and ability to learn, new technologies
Enthusiasm for complex distributed systems serving business and enterprise customers
nice: Experience designing and developing large distributed systems
details.benefits: US base pay range $131,400 – $197,200 a year; the offer within the range depends on work location, job-related skills, experience and education or training. The role is also eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits.
notes: Early-career friendly: 0–2 years of product development experience
Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities (contact hr@rubrik.com)
